name: The Living Rainbow Bridge
description: A breathtaking bridge composed of interlocking crystal steps that emit a continuous spectrum of colors, spanning a glowing canyon where luminous flora and fauna celebrate with light.
prompt: A magnificent Living Rainbow Bridge made of iridescent crystal steps that pulse with vivid colors, spanning a luminous canyon filled with bioluminescent flora and fauna, soft ambient lighting, dynamic reflection on water below, ultra‑detailed, fantasy landscape art.
caption: Step onto the Living Rainbow Bridge and walk through a cascade of colors—where every footfall paints a new hue 🌈🚶.
